data.rationale: The proposal has the same flow (open Find a Park by State, pick a state, find a park, click a section link) with matching parameters. It adds a separate "click the park entry" step that the true workflow doesn't have, and it names the control a "dropdown" rather than a button. Despite that, a browser automation could be built from the spec, since state, park and sub-page link are all named as parameters.
